purpose: Adapters for five strict nineteenth-century microscope-slide nodes where current custody can be tied to a dated institutional collection state, an original historical series, or a bounded surviving case.
guards: A current combined collection may contain nineteenth- and twentieth-century material; isolate the historical layer by creator, date, label, catalogue or original series rather than projecting the current total backwards.
Keep source-specific counts when current institutional summaries and historical collection literature use different attributions or totals; do not silently reconcile them.
Historical society collection size and present society holdings are separate dated states. A nineteenth-century count is not a present-survival count unless an item register closes that relation.
Original creator/preparer, later collector, donor and current custodian are distinct roles. A modern donation date does not date the microscope slides.
For compound embryological collections, preserve original subcollection and catalogue structure rather than treating a present aggregate preparation total as the Hubrecht nineteenth-century total.

adapters.institution_scope: Royal College of Surgeons of England John and Charles Tomes dental histology slide collection
adapters.target: Hunterian microscope-slide and odontological collection pages, RCS dental-history page, SurgiCat records and Tomes collection literature
adapters.promotion_rule: Recover John-versus-Charles creator attribution, RCSMS/item numbers, specimen taxon and dates slide by slide; retain c.1,880 combined and c.1,800 Charles-attributed published counts as source-specific claims until the item register resolves them, and isolate John's securely pre-1895 material for CORE_19C.

adapters.institution_scope: Quekett Microscopical Club historical slide collection and archives
adapters.target: QMC public archives pages, historical slide database project and published institutional history
adapters.promotion_rule: Capture present database/tray records when public, donor/preparer labels and nineteenth-century accession or exchange evidence; preserve the over-2,000 preparation state by 1873 separately from the present 20,000-plus slide holdings.

adapters.institution_scope: Museum für Naturkunde Berlin Embryology Collection / Ambrosius Hubrecht historical core
adapters.target: official Embryology Collection page, original Hubrecht catalogues and current subcollection documentation
adapters.promotion_rule: Use original Hubrecht catalogues and series documentation to isolate late-nineteenth-century embryos and histological slide series; treat the current 80,000-preparation figure as the aggregate Embryology Collection including later Hill, Bolk, Kükenthal, Spemann and other material.

adapters.institution_scope: OHSU Historical Collections & Archives Medical Museum Collection microscope-slide case
adapters.target: official OHSU Digital Collections record, Medical Museum Collection Box 42 metadata and IIIF manifest
adapters.promotion_rule: Preserve the approximately 94-slide nineteenth-century physical case as the object state and the February 1976 Brougher donation as a later custody event; harvest labels and IIIF images without inferring original ownership from the donor.

adapters.institution_scope: Science Museum Group Manchester Literary & Philosophical Society Andrew Pritchard slide case
adapters.target: official SMG object page, JSON catalogue entry and IIIF manifest for Y1997.6.14
adapters.promotion_rule: Treat the eleven-slide 1835 leather case as one bounded surviving set and preserve its later Manchester Literary & Philosophical Society and Science Museum Group custody separately from Pritchard manufacture.
